اجتذبن (form VIII)
# اِجْتَذَبْنَ (ijtaḏabna) /id͡ʒ.ta.ðab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اُجْتُذِبْنَ (ujtuḏibna) /ud͡ʒ.tu.ðib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اِجْتَذِبْنَ (ijtaḏibna) /id͡ʒ.ta.ðib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
